components.name: Embedded Linux Base Platform
components.description: 임베디드 리눅스 배포 기반 계층. 커널, 부트로더, 루트 파일시스템을 포함한다.

components.name: Linux Kernel
components.description: 장비 운영체제 커널. 스케줄링, 메모리 관리, 디바이스 드라이버 계층을 제공한다.

components.name: libcurl
components.description: 펌웨어 업데이트 다운로드 및 클라우드 원격 측정 업로드에 사용하는 HTTP/TLS 클라이언트.

components.name: Expat
components.description: 스트림 방식 XML 파서. 장치 기술 파일과 프로젝트 설정 처리에 사용된다.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: IEC 61850 SCL, PLCopen XML 등 설정 파일 파싱에 사용하는 XML 처리기.

components.name: wpa_supplicant
components.description: 무선 백홀 링크의 WPA2/WPA3 인증 및 키 교환을 수행하는 서플리컨트.

components.name: musl libc
components.description: 용량이 제한된 임베디드 이미지를 위한 경량 표준 C 라이브러리.

components.name: CODESYS Control Runtime System
components.description: IEC 61131-3 프로그램을 실행하는 제어 런타임. 온라인 변경과 통신 서버를 포함한다.

components.name: MGate Diagnostics and Event Logger
components.description: 장비 상태 이벤트, 진단 코드, 감사 로그를 수집하고 보관하는 모듈.

components.name: MGate Secure Boot and Attestation Module
components.description: 부팅 체인 무결성 측정과 서명 검증을 수행하는 보안 부트 모듈.

components.name: MGate Alarm and Event Engine
components.description: 임계값 감시, 알람 우선순위 판정, 확인/해제 상태 관리를 수행하는 엔진.

components.name: MGate Redundancy Management Module
components.description: 이중화 쌍 간 상태 동기화와 무중단 절체를 관리하는 모듈.

components.name: MGate I/O Scanner Module
components.description: 원격 I/O 및 필드 모듈과의 주기적 데이터 교환을 담당하는 스캐너 모듈.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

components.name: EtherNet/IP CIP Stack
components.description: EtherNet/IP 및 CIP 오브젝트 모델을 구현한 산업용 이더넷 스택.

components.name: PROFINET IO Device Stack
components.description: PROFINET IO 실시간 사이클릭 데이터 교환과 진단 알람 처리를 담당한다.

components.name: DNP3 Outstation Stack
components.description: DNP3 아웃스테이션 구현. 이벤트 클래스 폴링과 비요청 응답을 처리한다.

components.name: IEC 60870-5-104 Telecontrol Stack
components.description: 원방감시제어 통신 규약 스택. ASDU 송수신과 시간 동기를 처리한다.

vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow exists in curl 7.12.3 to and including curl 7.58.0 in the FTP URL handling that allows an attacker to cause a denial of service or worse.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Heap buffer overflow in the TFTP protocol handler in cURL 7.19.4 to 7.65.3.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The implementations of SAE in hostapd before 2.10 and wpa_supplicant before 2.10 are vulnerable to side channel attacks as a result of cache access patterns. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-9494.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: xmlparse.c in Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.5 allows attackers to insert namespace-separator characters into namespace URIs.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In Expat (aka libexpat) before 2.4.5, there is an integer overflow in storeRawNames.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A flaw was found in curl before version 7.51. If cookie state is written into a cookie jar file that is later read back and used for subsequent requests, a malicious HTTP server can inject new cookies for arbitrary domains into said cookie jar.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A vulnerability was discovered in how p2p/p2p_pd.c in wpa_supplicant before 2.10 processes P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) provision discovery requests. It could result in denial of service or other impact (potentially execution of arbitrary code), for an attacker within radio range.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In musl libc through 1.2.1, wcsnrtombs mishandles particular combinations of destination buffer size and source character limit, as demonstrated by an invalid write access (buffer overflow).

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In wpa_supplicant and hostapd 2.9, forging attacks may occur because AlgorithmIdentifier parameters are mishandled in tls/pkcs1.c and tls/x509v3.c.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
